meta.description: Rented GPU price tiers for normalisation. Prices are per GPU-hour excluding GST, on demand unless the row says otherwise. Each row says where it is hosted, for the data-residency rule. All priced rows are currently H100-class; previous-generation GPUs (L4, L40S, A100, T4) are welcome as sourced rows, since the calculator does not assume top-end hardware.

rows.label: IndiaAI portal, headline subsidised rate (eligibility required)
rows.note: PIB's February 2026 backgrounder (opened by the review council) says 38,000+ high-end GPUs are available at Rs 65 per hour; it does not call this an average. It cannot be an H100 rate: the L1 bid of Rs 153 less the 40% subsidy cap is at least Rs 91.8. Sources give about Rs 65 to 100 (the brief: 67 to 92). Eligibility: researchers, startups and MSMEs, students, government entities.
rows.verification: PIB PDF opened by the review council; portal not opened

rows.label: IndiaAI portal, H100 SXM on demand, L1 bid before subsidy (eligibility required)
rows.note: Read from the portal calculator by a secondary source on 1 Nov 2026; excludes GST and the subsidy (capped at 40%).

rows.label: Indian commercial cloud, H100 SXM list price
rows.note: Shakti Cloud and Yotta list Rs 356; E2E Rs 379.05 (secondary reading, Oct to Nov 2026). The brief's older figure was about Rs 217.

rows.label: Hyperscaler, H100 reserved capacity block, Mumbai region
rows.note: AWS Capacity Block (reserved, not on-demand) price per H100-hour as reported by a secondary source; GST treatment not confirmed. The brief cited 2.50 to 4.00 USD for hyperscalers generally. Replace with an on-demand price page.
